newsitem.title: USA: Paging Network, Premiere in marketing pact.
newsitem.headline: Paging Network, Premiere in marketing pact.

text.p: Paging Network Inc and Premiere Technologies Inc said on Thursday they have signed an agreement to market each other's services.

Paging Network, a wireless messaging company, initially will offer Premiere's worldlink communications services to a small segment of its customers, marketing Premiere services through telemarketing, direct mail and promotional inserts.

Premiere, a network-based computer telephony company, will offer Paging Network's paging services to a portion of Premiere WorldLink subscribers through fulfillment inserts for new customers and statement inserts for current customers, the companies said in a joint statement.
